> **Narrowed 2026-10-14 (Sue).** An open issue describes exactly the remaining work (backlog-workflow rule).
>
> **Resolved so far:** options 1 and 3 landed in db2e63b18 (v0.11.0): .gitignore:99-106 un-ignores the config CSVs by name and scripts/api_surface_audit.py check_untracked_inputs() fails on any hashed-suffix untracked file under _/ (pinned by tests/test_api_discoverability.py).
>
> **Remaining (this issue):** option 2: delete the five pd.Series(unitlabels).to_csv('unitlabels.csv') writers (ghanasps.py:124, ghanalss.py:282, ethiopia.py:241, togo.py:127, tanzania.py:527) and the two uncalled readers harmonized_unit_labels() (ethiopia.py:21, tanzania.py:574); keep GhanaLSS/_/unit_labels.csv (tracked). Confirm nothing imports those readers. Auto-dispatchable; a country-module edit re-warms each of the five countries.

---
*Original text, kept for the evidence:*

Generated .csv in a country _/ is gitignored yet hashed: cache freshness becomes local to your checkout (Ethiopia, GhanaLSS, GhanaSPS latent)

## A generated file that is gitignored *and* hashed makes cache state local to your checkout

Found while verifying "nothing unrelated moves" for #783 (PR #789): Uganda's 28 cache hashes differed between two checkouts of the same commit. Cause was `Uganda/_/fct_usda.csv` — untracked, gitignored by `.gitignore:62` (`*.csv`), yet `.csv` is in `_BUILD_INPUT_SUFFIXES` so it is hashed as a build input. Tracked in `63999bc8`.

@ligon's point: that file was untracked **because it is generated**, so the question is not which generated files happen to exist, but **which countries have code that can generate one**. Audited on that basis:

| generated target | countries | on disk | tracked | status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `panel_ids.json`, `updated_ids.json` | Burkina_Faso, Ethiopia, EthiopiaRHS, GhanaLSS, Mali, Niger | yes | **yes** | fine — generated but committed |
| **`unitlabels.csv`** | **Ethiopia, GhanaLSS, GhanaSPS** | **no** | **no** (gitignored) | **latent: appears when the generator runs** |

`ethiopia.py:241`, `ghanalss.py:281` and `ghanasps.py:146` each do `pd.Series(unitlabels).to_csv('unitlabels.csv')`. Run any of them and a CSV materialises in the country's `_/`, is silently swallowed by `*.csv`, and immediately shifts **every** cache hash for that country — invisibly, and differently from every other checkout. Uganda's bug, latent in three more places.

### It is not merely stray output — the file is read as well

`ethiopia.py:21`: `def harmonized_unit_labels(fn='../../_/unitlabels.csv', key='Code', value='Preferred Label')`, which `pd.read_csv`s it. So the module both produces and consumes it, and the write is a **side effect of computing prices** (`ethiopia.py:241`, mid-function, right before `return prices`). Since the file is absent from the repo, that reader can only succeed after somebody has run the writer — an ordering dependency carried by the filesystem rather than by code.

### The structural conflict

`.gitignore:62` blanket-ignores `*.csv` (beside `*.dta`, `*.sav`) to keep **microdata** out of git. But `_BUILD_INPUT_SUFFIXES = {.py, .csv, .json, .txt, .tab, .tsv}` makes any `.csv` in a country's `_/` a **hashed build input**. Those two rules are in direct conflict for the config directory: a file can be invisible to git and load-bearing for cache freshness at the same time. Nine `.csv` files under `countries/` are already force-added past the ignore, which shows the conflict has been worked around case by case rather than resolved.

### Options

1. **Un-ignore the config directory**: `!lsms_library/countries/*/_/*.csv` (and the wave-level twin). Generated or curated CSVs then show up in `git status` instead of hiding. Low risk — `_/` is config, microdata lives in `Data/`.
2. **Stop writing `unitlabels.csv` as a side effect.** If `harmonized_unit_labels` has no callers (it appears not to), the write and the reader are both dead and should go rather than be tracked.
3. **A guard**: fail if any hashed-suffix file under a country's `_/` is untracked. Cheap, and it turns this class from "discovered while debugging something else" into a check. `scripts/api_surface_audit.py` is the natural home.

(1) and (3) are complementary; (2) depends on whether that reader is live. Not fixing unilaterally — the `.gitignore` change has repo-wide blast radius.

— Sue
title: Five country modules still write unitlabels.csv into _/ as a side effect (ghanasps, ghanalss, ethiopia, togo, tanzania); two readers have no callers
